card.name: Of and million inside statistics
card.fires_on: Small words like "of", "million", "people" or "than" right after a number or percentage in a statistics sentence, where a count of people or things comes next. Mostly global health figures such as HIV and cancer counts.

modes.label: Of after a figure
modes.description: The word "of" after a percentage, a fraction or the word "number", just before the group being counted.

modes.label: Unit word after a count
modes.description: "million" or "people" right after a quantity in a statistic.
modes.example: 119countries reported a total of 95<< million>> people tested in 2010

modes.label: Comparison or approximation word
modes.description: Words like "almost" or "than" that lead into a stated amount.
modes.example: The wings are covered in<< almost>> 12,000 solar

card.writes: It pushes toward a precise next word and away from vague large-quantity words like thousands, hundreds and millions.
card.plain: It fires in statistics sentences at the small word between a number and the group it counts, and discourages vague words like "thousands".
